official_measurement_examples.name: 20 cubic metre threshold
official_measurement_examples.fact: Environment Agency guidance updated 2 July 2026 says abstractions over 20 cubic metres a day are likely to need a licence, while qualifying abstractions at or below 20 cubic metres a day can be exempt.

official_measurement_examples.name: Combined operation rule
official_measurement_examples.fact: The 20 cubic metre exemption is assessed across the same source where multiple abstraction points form one operation; it is not automatically 20 cubic metres per point.

official_measurement_examples.name: Licence types
official_measurement_examples.fact: Full, transfer, temporary and impounding licences serve different purposes and must not be treated as interchangeable permissions.

official_measurement_examples.name: CAMS availability
official_measurement_examples.fact: A catchment abstraction strategy indicates water availability and licensing context but does not itself grant an abstraction right.

official_measurement_examples.name: Licence conditions
official_measurement_examples.fact: Granted abstraction rights can be volume, period and flow-condition limited; a licence is not an unlimited water-capacity guarantee.

official_measurement_examples.name: Planning separation
official_measurement_examples.fact: An abstraction licence does not grant planning permission, land rights or any separate environmental permit needed for associated works.

official_measurement_examples.name: Current compliance regime
official_measurement_examples.fact: Environment Agency compliance guidance updated June 2026 assesses licence-condition non-compliance separately from planning control.

official_measurement_examples.name: Parcel limitation
official_measurement_examples.fact: Water-resource licensing context does not prove parcel ownership, borehole feasibility, guaranteed long-term supply or final development yield.

core_rules: licence exemption is not planning permission
full transfer temporary and impounding licences remain distinct
CAMS availability is not licence grant
licence volume is not guaranteed future capacity
licence conditions can restrict timing and flows
abstraction licence is distinct from environmental permit
abstraction licence is distinct from land rights
abstraction licence is distinct from planning permission
public notice is not licence grant
withdrawn application is not current permission
licence does not establish parcel ownership
licence does not calculate development yield
no parcel water-resource clearance or Future Growth score may be promoted while recovery is parked
